title: Charge Coach
goal: While the phone charges, show how fast it is charging and warn at 80% to protect the battery.
build: Show the battery % and whether the phone is charging, updating live
Every minute, work out how much % was gained and label it Fast / Normal / Slow
When the battery reaches 80% while charging, show an alert: “Unplug now to protect your battery”
bonus: Show “time to full” based on the current speed.
hint: BroadcastReceiver for ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED (level, plugged).

title: Drain Detective
goal: Track how fast the battery drops and show which hour drained the most.
build: Save the battery % with the time, every 15 minutes while the app is open (or with a Save button)
Show the saved readings as a list or a simple bar chart
Highlight the “worst drain hour”: the hour with the biggest % drop
bonus: Keep recording in the background with WorkManager.
hint: BatteryManager for the level; SharedPreferences or Room to save readings.

title: Unplug Reminder
goal: Nag the user to unplug when the phone has been at 100% on the charger for too long.
build: Detect “charging AND battery at 100%” and start a timer
After a set time (e.g. 2 minutes for the demo), play a loud, annoying alarm and show “Battery full: UNPLUG NOW”
The alarm stops only when the charger is unplugged
Count and show total “overcharge minutes saved”
bonus: Let the user choose the delay and the alarm sound.
hint: ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED + ACTION_POWER_DISCONNECTED; MediaPlayer for the alarm.

title: Heat Guard
goal: Watch the battery temperature and warn when the phone gets too hot.
build: Show the battery temperature in °C, updating live
Let the user set a limit (e.g. 40 °C)
Above the limit, show a warning: “Your phone is hot: stop gaming or charging”
Keep a list of every time it went over the limit (time + temperature)
bonus: Colour the temperature green / orange / red.
hint: ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED gives EXTRA_TEMPERATURE in tenths of a degree.

title: Wi-Fi Signal Mapper
goal: Find the best and worst Wi-Fi spots in a building.
build: Show the current Wi-Fi signal strength (bars or dBm)
A “Save spot” button that asks for a room name and saves it with the signal
List all saved rooms sorted from strongest to weakest
Mark the best room and the worst room clearly
bonus: Show a colour bar for each room.
hint: WifiManager.getConnectionInfo().rssi (needs location permission on newer Android).

title: Speed Snapshot
goal: Test internet speed and find the user’s fastest time of day.
build: A “Test now” button that downloads one small file and times it
Show the speed in Mbps
Save every result with the time of day
Show “Your fastest hour” from the saved results
bonus: Draw the results as a simple chart.
hint: Download a fixed-size file (e.g. 1–5 MB) with HttpURLConnection/OkHttp and time it.

title: Notification Noise Meter
goal: Count which apps send the most notifications.
build: Ask for notification access with a clear explanation screen
Count notifications per app while the app is allowed to listen
Show a ranked list: “noisiest” app at the top, with its count
bonus: Show today’s total and a “quietest app” award.
hint: NotificationListenerService (user enables it in Settings).

title: Permission Watchdog
goal: Show which installed apps can use the camera, microphone or location.
build: List installed apps that request Camera, Microphone or Location
Show small icons for which of the three each app has
Flag apps that “probably shouldn’t need it” (e.g. a calculator with microphone access)
bonus: Tap an app to open its Settings page.
hint: PackageManager.getInstalledPackages(GET_PERMISSIONS) → requestedPermissions.

title: App Update Age
goal: Find apps that haven’t been updated in a long time, a security check.
build: List installed apps with their last update date
Sort with the oldest first
Mark apps not updated for 90+ days as “Needs attention”
Show a score: “X of Y apps are up to date”
bonus: Button to open the app’s Play Store page.
hint: PackageInfo.lastUpdateTime from PackageManager.

title: Data Budget Buddy
goal: Set a daily mobile-data limit and warn the user before they cross it.
build: Let the user set a daily limit in MB
Show mobile data used today as a progress ring
Alert at 80% of the limit and again at 100%
bonus: Remember the last 7 days and show them as bars.
hint: TrafficStats.getMobileRxBytes()/getMobileTxBytes(); save today’s starting value.

title: Night Owl Tracker
goal: Track late-night phone use and give a “sleep disturbance” score.
build: Record each time the screen turns on between 11 PM and 6 AM
Show tonight’s count and total minutes
Turn it into a simple score out of 100 (more night use = lower score)
bonus: Show the last 7 nights as a chart.
hint: Register for ACTION_SCREEN_ON / ACTION_SCREEN_OFF while the app (or a service) runs.

title: Data Hog Alert
goal: Spot an app using a lot of mobile data and warn the user.
build: Ask for usage access with a clear explanation screen
Show mobile data used per app in the last hour, highest first
Alert when any app uses more than a set amount (e.g. 50 MB) in that hour
bonus: Let the user “ignore” trusted apps.
hint: NetworkStatsManager.querySummary (needs Usage Access in Settings).

title: Charger Roulette
goal: Grade each charger or cable by how fast it charges.
build: When plugged in, measure how much % is gained in a short test (e.g. 3–5 minutes)
Turn the speed into a grade from A (fast) to F (slow)
Save the result with a name the user types (“Bedroom cable”)
Show all chargers with their grades, best first
bonus: Re-test a charger and show if it got better or worse.
hint: ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED level + a timer while plugged in.

title: Ghost Drain Hunter
goal: Find out how much battery the phone loses while the screen is off.
build: Note the battery % and time when the screen turns off
Note them again when the screen turns on
Show the % lost per hour while the screen was off
Flag “Something is draining your phone in your pocket” above a set rate
bonus: Keep a history of each screen-off period.
hint: ACTION_SCREEN_OFF / ACTION_SCREEN_ON + battery level.

title: Pick-Up Reflex
goal: Measure how quickly the user reacts to a notification, a “how hooked are you?” score.
build: The app sends its own test notification at a random moment
Measure the time until the user taps it
Show the reaction time and a label: “Lightning”, “Normal”, “Calm”
Keep a list of past results and the average
bonus: A 5-round “challenge mode” with a final score.
hint: NotificationCompat + a PendingIntent that opens the app; compare timestamps.

title: Phone Age Report
goal: Make one shareable “report card” about the user’s phone.
build: Show the phone model, Android version and storage used/free
Show the oldest app’s install date as “phone in use since”
Show the battery health and temperature
Put it all on one nice card with a “phone mood” emoji
bonus: A Share button that shares the card as an image.
hint: Build.MODEL, StatFs for storage, PackageInfo.firstInstallTime, battery intent.

title: Fast Drain Alarm
goal: Alert when the battery drops too fast.
build: Let the user set a rule, e.g. “more than 10% in 1 hour”
Check the battery % regularly while the app runs
Alert when the rule is broken, showing how fast it dropped
bonus: Name the app most used in that hour (usage access).
hint: Battery level readings over time; UsageStatsManager for the bonus.

title: Clock Drift Checker
goal: Check how many seconds the phone’s clock is off from real internet time.
build: Fetch the current time from an internet time API
Compare it with the phone’s clock and show “X seconds fast/slow”
Save each check with the date to show a history
bonus: Colour the result green if under 2 seconds.
hint: Any public time API over HTTPS (e.g. worldtimeapi.org); compare with System.currentTimeMillis().

title: Touch Test Lab
goal: Help users find dead pixels and dead touch areas on their screen.
build: A full-screen colour test: tap to switch between red, green, blue, white and black
A touch grid: each square lights up when the finger passes over it
Show how many squares were reached, and mark the ones never touched
bonus: A “Pass / Check again” result screen.
hint: A custom View with onTouchEvent; no permissions needed.

title: Shake Meter
goal: Measure how hard and how often the phone is shaken.
build: Show live shake strength from the motion sensor
Count each shake above a threshold
Show the strongest shake of the session
Save each session (shakes + strongest) to a history list
bonus: A 10-second “shake challenge” with a high score.
hint: SensorManager + TYPE_ACCELEROMETER; strength = √(x²+y²+z²) − gravity.

title: QR Safety Scanner
goal: Scan a QR code and warn if its link looks suspicious before opening it.
build: Scan a QR code with the camera
Show the link it contains
Flag warning signs: not HTTPS, IP address instead of a name, link shorteners, odd words like “login-verify”
Buttons: “Open anyway” and “Don’t open”
bonus: Keep a history of scanned links with their verdict.
hint: Google ML Kit barcode scanning (or the ZXing library).

title: Photo Twin Finder
goal: Find exact duplicate photos.
build: Let the user pick a folder or several photos
Compare files by size, then by a file hash, to find exact copies
Show duplicates side by side with their sizes
Show the total space that could be freed
bonus: Delete a chosen copy (with confirmation).
hint: Photo picker / Storage Access Framework; MessageDigest (MD5) for the hash.

title: Website Response Checker
goal: Check how fast a list of websites responds.
build: Let the user add website addresses to a list
A “Check all” button that requests each site and times the response
Show each site with its time in ms and a green / orange / red dot
Mark the fastest and the slowest site
bonus: Show “down” for sites that don’t respond.
hint: HttpURLConnection or OkHttp in a coroutine/thread; time each request.

title: Smart Brightness Advisor
goal: Tell the user when their screen is brighter than the room needs.
build: Read the room’s light level from the light sensor
Read the current screen brightness
If the screen is much brighter than needed, suggest a lower level
Show a simple “battery you could save” estimate
bonus: A one-tap button to apply the suggested brightness.
hint: TYPE_LIGHT sensor; Settings.System.SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS to read brightness.

title: Compass Health Check
goal: Show the compass direction and warn when magnets are disturbing it.
build: Show a live compass needle and the direction in degrees (N, E, S, W)
Show the magnetic field strength
Warn “Magnetic interference!” when the strength is unusual
Show a “move your phone in a figure 8” instruction screen to recalibrate
bonus: Show when the reading becomes steady again.
hint: TYPE_MAGNETIC_FIELD + TYPE_ACCELEROMETER with SensorManager.getRotationMatrix.

title: Deadline Collision Alert
goal: Spot days when too many deadlines pile up.
build: Let the user add tasks with a name and a due date
Show the tasks grouped by date
Warn “Busy day!” on any date with 3 or more deadlines
Show the next 7 days at a glance
bonus: A reminder notification the day before a busy day.
hint: DatePickerDialog + a list saved with Room or SharedPreferences.

title: Network Info Detective
goal: Show the details of the current internet connection in one place.
build: Show whether the phone is on Wi-Fi, mobile data or offline
For Wi-Fi: show the network name, IP address, signal strength and link speed
Update the screen when the connection changes
bonus: A Copy button for the details.
hint: ConnectivityManager + WifiManager.getConnectionInfo() (location permission for the name).

title: Sunlight Exposure Monitor
goal: Track how much bright light the user gets during the day.
build: Show the live light level from the light sensor
Label it Dark / Indoor / Bright / Sunlight
Count the minutes spent in each label while the app runs
Show a simple daily summary
bonus: An alert after a long time in the dark: “Go get some sunlight!”
hint: SensorManager + TYPE_LIGHT (lux).

title: Duplicate Contact Finder
goal: Find contacts saved more than once.
build: Ask for contacts permission
Read all contacts with their phone numbers
Group contacts that share the same number (ignore spaces and +91)
Show each group of duplicates
bonus: Also match very similar names.
hint: ContactsContract with a ContentResolver query.

title: Parking Spot Saver
goal: Save where the vehicle is parked and help the user walk back to it.
build: A “Save my parking spot” button that saves the GPS location and time
Show the saved spot and how long ago it was saved
Show the distance to the car from where the user is now
A “Navigate” button that opens Google Maps to the spot
bonus: Add a note or photo (“Level 2, pillar B”).
hint: FusedLocationProviderClient; Location.distanceTo(); a geo: intent for Maps.
